fact: The Minister's reply states the Coding and Robotics CAPS for Grades R-9 is finalised and approved by Umalusi, with Foundation Phase implementation postponed from 2025 to 2026 and grade-by-grade roll-out to follow, while 1770 schools continue to pilot the draft; it is not yet a compulsory subject for secondary grades.
title: Question to the Minister of Basic Education - NW451
